common.text: Authorities in Germany have briefly shut down an airport, according to ABC News. Details about the emergency call were not immediately available. Earlier on Tuesday, authorities noted a possible drone sighting at the airport.
Here is the headline: Smart ring maker Ultrahuman to roll out biological-age model across blank. Where did it happen? Brazil, the United Arab Emirates, or Namibia?
Here is what matters: in the UK, 3.6 million people work in catering and hospitality. All of these kitchens cooked with fossil gas or propane, according to Guardian Business.
Starfield City drew 2-2 with Ledgerton Rovers after Rafe Lindqvist scored in the last minute. Rovers had led twice through goals from striker Teo Vance, Pixelburg Sport reports.

world.text: Donald Trump's deal to buy Russian diesel has been met with fury from Volodymyr Zelenskyy, who said it was a weak decision and would generate billions in extra revenue for Putin's war effort. The Ukrainian president has also rejected US calls for an energy ceasefire.

cosmos.text: Scientists have discovered a protein that may help harmful ageing cells hide from the immune system, allowing them to build up and fuel age-related health problems. Blocking the protein in mice reduced these cells and the inflammation, ScienceDaily reports.
Voyager Technologies' Griffin-1 has completed environmental testing at NASA JPL. The tests show that the spacecraft is ready to face the harsh conditions of launch.
El Nino has continued to strengthen, with several key measures now in record territory. These measurements come from the region of the equatorial Pacific used to monitor El Nino.

money.text: Oil prices rose on recent reports that Iran attacked ships in the Strait of Hormuz. But the stock quickly erased those gains, moving between gains and losses, Euronews Business reports.
Our number of the day: 3.6 million. In the UK, 3.6 million people work in catering and hospitality.
On Monday morning, the world's economists tuned in to an announcement from Sweden to learn who won this year's Nobel Prize in economics.

news60.text: Former Congolese President Joseph Kabila has launched a new political and military coalition against the current government. It took control of Goma, the capital of North Kivu province, according to ABC News.
Hurricane Simon is lurking off the Mexican coast. Though it remained offshore, the storm lashed coastal areas with high winds.
A BA flight was forced to turn back over a cracked window, BBC Business reports. Passengers reported oxygen masks dropping in the cabin.
